register.labelZh: COME ROUND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: COME ROUND Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: come round 可以自然地描述某人暈倒後重新恢復知覺。；come round 和 come around 可用於友善地邀請別人到家中短暫探訪。；come round 可以描述人或車輛轉過街角或彎位後出現。；come round 可以描述卡片、表格或其他文件在人與人之間傳遞。
register.summaryEn: Come round gives you a natural way to describe someone becoming conscious again after fainting. Come round and come around are useful for friendly invitations and short visits to somebody’s home. Come round can describe a person or vehicle appearing after moving around a corner or bend. Come round can describe a card, form or other document being passed from one person to another.
